leadText: The Challenge of Life is the opening theme song for the English dub of the twenty-second season, Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends. It was used from Lillier and the Staff! to Dreams of the Sun and Moon!. The opening animation is composed of clips from the third and fourth Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon Japanese openings, Future Connection and Your Adventure, as well as a clip from Episode 3 of Where Are You Going, Eevee?, while the ending animation is composed of clips from the second Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon Japanese ending, Twerp, Twerpette.
